title: reference-integrity-v1 task input
description: A paper's reference list plus the set of in-text citation marker ids. The player must judge, per reference, whether it has an integrity problem (retracted DOI, mismatched/miscited metadata, dangling cited-but-absent or listed-but-uncited, a missing known replication, an invalid/malformed DOI, a predatory-journal venue, or a paper-mill tortured-phrase title).

references.description: The bibliography. One entry per listed reference.

title.description: Title as listed (may carry a paper-mill tortured phrase the arena injected).

doi.description: DOI as listed (may carry a retraction marker, or be structurally malformed, where the arena injected it).

venue.description: Publication outlet / journal as listed (may be a predatory outlet the arena injected).

cited_in_text.description: Whether this reference is cited somewhere in the body text.

in_text_marker_ids.description: Every citation marker id that appears in the body text. A marker with no matching reference is a dangling-missing citation.
